premises.text: Excess antibiotics drive side effects and antimicrobial resistance
premises.evidence_span: taking too many antibiotics can pose a danger to our health because of side effects as well as antimicrobial resistance

premises.text: Phages are natural and precise bacterial killers that spare good bacteria
Dermatologists are the top antibiotic prescribers, so skin is the first application area
premises.evidence_span: Dermatologists are actually the number one prescribers of antibiotics across healthcare

premises.text: Precision serums require matching tests because efficacy depends on which organism overgrows
premises.evidence_span: if we were going to bring a precision serum or solution to market, we better have a test

premises.text: Four-swab kit with control, robotics prep, and whole genome sequencing characterize full skin microbiome including fungi and mites
premises.evidence_span: in addition to bacteria, we can also see viruses and fungi, even mites

premises.text: Algorithm outputs microbiome type, scores, ingredient recommendations, and matched phage serum
premises.evidence_span: recommendations on food ingredients, skin care ingredients, as well as her phage serum that's right for her

premises.text: Eight formulations from biobank strains are selected by rapid discovery and produced at high titer in bioreactors
premises.evidence_span: We use bioreactors to produce and scale phages at extremely high titer

premises.text: Largest skin microbiome WGS database underpins the platform
premises.evidence_span: we amassed the largest database on the skin microbiome to date using whole genome sequencing

value.text: Precision phage-based skin solutions matched to the patient's microbiome to reduce antibiotic dependence
value.evidence_span: get people off of Accutane and antibiotics

secondary_value.text: Broader human-health phage platform beyond skin
secondary_value.evidence_span: platform that is applicable to many areas of human health

causal_links.evidence_span: Phages are microbes that infect bacteria
Skin Microbiome Discovery Kit and custom phage serums
